statement: A natural first-degree holomorphic Stiefel SOS ansatz cannot certify ANY non-PSD witness, independently of dimension: if a Hermitian W on C^p tensor C^q admits the exact polynomial identity f_W(A,B)-gamma*||B||_F^2 = sum_j |ell_j(A,B)|^2 + sum_(h=1)^4 g_h(A) * b^* H_h b, with gamma>=0, each ell_j holomorphic bilinear in A in C^(p x 2) and B in C^(q x 2), each H_h a constant Hermitian 2q x 2q matrix, and g_1,g_2,g_3,g_4 the real entries of A^*A-I_2, then necessarily W>=gamma I. Thus this restricted certificate cannot certify the explicit non-PSD KG witness candidate, let alone an indecomposable detector. This is a limitation of the specified proof ansatz, not a 4x4 or proper-state-family no-go.
proof: Let a=vec(A) in C^p tensor C^2 and b=vec(B) in C^q tensor C^2. Regroup the Hermitian coefficient operator of f_W on a tensor b as M_W=W tensor [Omega_2], where the two auxiliary factors are grouped with Alice and Bob. Each holomorphic bilinear square contributes to an ordinary PSD Gram operator P>=0. Write G_1=I_p tensor |0><0|, G_2=I_p tensor |1><1|, and take G_3,G_4 to represent the real and imaginary offdiagonal entries of A^*A. Comparing the terms constant in A forces H_1+H_2=gamma I_(2q). Comparing the biquadratic coefficients, which are unique in the independent monomials conjugate(a_i)*a_j*conjugate(b_k)*b_l, gives M_W=P+sum_h G_h tensor H_h. Slice auxiliary Alice in |1> and auxiliary Bob in |0>: the Omega term vanishes, G_2=1 and G_1=G_3=G_4=0, so 0=P_10+I_p tensor (H_2)_00 and (H_2)_00<=0. Slice auxiliary Alice and Bob both in |0>: M_W becomes W and the equality gives W=P_00+I_p tensor (H_1)_00 >= gamma I, because (H_1)_00=gamma I-(H_2)_00>=gamma I. All PSD slice statements are ordinary Hermitian principal-compression facts.
actual_candidate_consequence: The explicit rational KG candidate W_cand in frontier-20261029-kg-rational-witness-candidate-v1.json SHA256 e0aedbbe98e5656bd0b40bf16bc8e5c5daa25d81064f78116ae198109d596b2b has the exact negative expectation <A|W_cand|A>=-531/100, so it cannot have a certificate of the restricted form above for any gamma>=0. This does not decide whether W_cand is 2-block positive. The complete rational Putinar certificate format in frontier-20261029-rational-sos-witness-bridge-v1.md SHA256 54eee5758d09b42b354d5138e696520f462f7eb33701fabcdc8e1a5fd96b262b allows general real polynomial squares, a ball multiplier, and A-dependent equality multipliers; none is ruled out by this lemma.
limits: The proof applies only to the specified holomorphic-bilinear SOS with constant B-Hermitian quadratic equality multipliers and no other terms; it does not rule out more general degree-four real SOS, antiholomorphic bilinears, higher-degree multipliers, or the complete rational SOS hierarchy.
